content: In a footnote on his introduction, Melvin-Koushki lists Nafsat I and Nafsat II together with the creedal tracts R. Iʿtiqādāt and R. Iʿtiqādiyya as the apologies, written during the trial of 829/1426 and after the events of 830/1427.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Iʿtiqādāt and R. Iʿtiqādiyya (per MK fn.44)
